Mathias Kaminsky

Caleb Dunne's Division partner in Extremis Malis, killed by Mantis during the opening Chinatown warehouse encounter.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

The opening loss

Kaminsky's death is the event that turns the New York lead into Caleb's personal pursuit of Mantis. The archive records it as a major spoiler because the official edition uses it to launch the full prequel route. [1]
